options: The auditions for India's first ever
reality based pop band hunt is
with numerous entries which came in.
questions.solution:
B) is'के बदले 'are' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि वाक्य का Subject 'auditions’ Plural है जिसके लिए Plural Verb का प्रयोग होगा।
B) 'are' will be used instead of 'is' because the subject 'auditions' of the sentence is plural for which Plural Verb will be used.

questions.q:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer
A property dealer was/shoot dead by four unidentified jacket-clad men/while taking a morning walk/in the park.
options: shoot dead by four unidentified jacket-clad men
questions.solution:
B) 'shoot'के बदले 'shot' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि Passive Voice में 'Be' क्रिया के साथ V3 का प्रयोग होता है और 'shoot' (गोली मारना) का V2 तथा V3 रूप में 'shot' होता है।
B) 'shot' will be used instead of 'shoot' because in Passive Voice V3 is used with the verb 'Be' and 'shoot' is used as V2 and V3 as 'shot'.

questions.q:
Comprehension:
In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.
Development in Bhopalaram village, situated in the Lunkaransar block of Bikaner, Rajasthan, has come to a halt due to the lack of proper roads. The absence of a _____1_____ road is a significant challenge for the nearly two thousand residents in the village. According to 47-year-old resident Baluram Jat, the main road connecting the village to the block headquarters was constructed around eight years ago and has not been maintained _____2______, rendering it _____3_____.The road's ______4_____ condition has made it challenging even for families to transport patients to the hospital. During Vimla's childbirth, the ambulance broke down due to the damaged road, forcing the family to arrange a private vehicle to reach the hospital. Vimla, a 28-year-old young woman from the village, noted that her condition worsened due to the road's large potholes. She highlighted that many pregnant women in the village prefer going to their parental homes for childbirth due to these challenges. ______5______, for those unable to do so, the journey to the hospital becomes exceedingly difficult.
Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
questions.solution:
D) Paved का use होगा क्योंकि "paved" का अर्थ होता है पक्की सड़क। sentence में mention है कि मुख्य सड़क, जो गांव को मुख्यालय से जोड़ती है, की मरम्मत नहीं की गई है, जिससे यह क्षतिग्रस्त हो गई है। इसलिए, 'paved' यहां सही है। जबकि 'Associated' का अर्थ है संबंधित, जो सड़क के संदर्भ में सही नहीं है। 'Developed' का अर्थ है विकसित, जो यहां इस संदर्भ में फिट नहीं बैठता क्योंकि यह सड़क की स्थिति को नहीं दर्शाता। 'Underdeveloped' का अर्थ है अविकसित, लेकिन यहां पर ध्यान पक्की सड़क पर है, न कि विकास पर।
'Paved' will be used because it means a road that is covered with concrete or asphalt. The sentence mentions that the main road connecting the village has not been maintained, making 'paved' appropriate here. Whereas 'Associated' means related, which is not fitting in the context of the road. 'Developed' means advanced, which doesn’t align with the focus on the road's physical condition. 'Underdeveloped' means not fully developed, but here the emphasis is on the paved road, not development.

questions.q:
Comprehension:
In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.
Development in Bhopalaram village, situated in the Lunkaransar block of Bikaner, Rajasthan, has come to a halt due to the lack of proper roads. The absence of a _____1_____ road is a significant challenge for the nearly two thousand residents in the village. According to 47-year-old resident Baluram Jat, the main road connecting the village to the block headquarters was constructed around eight years ago and has not been maintained _____2______, rendering it _____3_____.The road's ______4_____ condition has made it challenging even for families to transport patients to the hospital. During Vimla's childbirth, the ambulance broke down due to the damaged road, forcing the family to arrange a private vehicle to reach the hospital. Vimla, a 28-year-old young woman from the village, noted that her condition worsened due to the road's large potholes. She highlighted that many pregnant women in the village prefer going to their parental homes for childbirth due to these challenges. ______5______, for those unable to do so, the journey to the hospital becomes exceedingly difficult.
Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
questions.solution:
A) 'Since' का use होगा क्योंकि 'since' का अर्थ होता है किसी घटना के बाद से एक समय अवधि को दर्शाना। यहाँ यह उल्लेख किया गया है कि सड़क लगभग आठ साल पहले बनाई गई थी, और तब से इसे बनाए नहीं रखा गया है। इस प्रकार, 'since' सही है क्योंकि यह अवधि को दर्शाता है। जबकि 'When' का उपयोग एक समय बिंदु को इंगित करने के लिए होता है, 'From' किसी स्थान या स्थिति की शुरुआत का संकेत देता है, और 'For' अवधि या उद्देश्य को दर्शाता है, जो इस context में सही नहीं है।
'Since' will be used because it indicates a period starting from a specific event. The sentence states that the road was constructed around eight years ago and hasn't been maintained since then. Thus, 'since' is correct as it reflects the ongoing time span. 'When' indicates a point in time, 'From' signals the starting point of a situation, and 'For' indicates duration or purpose, which do not fit in this context.

questions.q:
Comprehension:
In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.
Development in Bhopalaram village, situated in the Lunkaransar block of Bikaner, Rajasthan, has come to a halt due to the lack of proper roads. The absence of a _____1_____ road is a significant challenge for the nearly two thousand residents in the village. According to 47-year-old resident Baluram Jat, the main road connecting the village to the block headquarters was constructed around eight years ago and has not been maintained _____2______, rendering it _____3_____.The road's ______4_____ condition has made it challenging even for families to transport patients to the hospital. During Vimla's childbirth, the ambulance broke down due to the damaged road, forcing the family to arrange a private vehicle to reach the hospital. Vimla, a 28-year-old young woman from the village, noted that her condition worsened due to the road's large potholes. She highlighted that many pregnant women in the village prefer going to their parental homes for childbirth due to these challenges. ______5______, for those unable to do so, the journey to the hospital becomes exceedingly difficult.
Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
questions.solution:
D) 'Impassable' का use होगा क्योंकि "impassable" का अर्थ होता है ऐसा मार्ग जिस पर यात्रा करना संभव नहीं हो। Sentence में mention है कि सड़क का रखरखाव नहीं हुआ है, जिसके कारण वह यात्रा के लिए अनुपयोगी हो गई है। इसलिए 'impassable' यहाँ सही है। जबकि 'Improbable' का अर्थ है असंभव, 'Deplorable' का अर्थ है दयनीय, और 'Answerable' का अर्थ है उत्तरदायी, जो इस context में सही नहीं हैं।
'Impassable' will be used because it means a road or path that is impossible to travel on. The sentence mentions that the road has not been maintained, making it unfit for travel, so 'impassable' fits well here. Whereas 'Improbable' means unlikely, 'Deplorable' means deserving condemnation, and 'Answerable' means responsible, which do not fit in this context.

questions.q:
Comprehension:
In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.
Development in Bhopalaram village, situated in the Lunkaransar block of Bikaner, Rajasthan, has come to a halt due to the lack of proper roads. The absence of a _____1_____ road is a significant challenge for the nearly two thousand residents in the village. According to 47-year-old resident Baluram Jat, the main road connecting the village to the block headquarters was constructed around eight years ago and has not been maintained _____2______, rendering it _____3_____.The road's ______4_____ condition has made it challenging even for families to transport patients to the hospital. During Vimla's childbirth, the ambulance broke down due to the damaged road, forcing the family to arrange a private vehicle to reach the hospital. Vimla, a 28-year-old young woman from the village, noted that her condition worsened due to the road's large potholes. She highlighted that many pregnant women in the village prefer going to their parental homes for childbirth due to these challenges. ______5______, for those unable to do so, the journey to the hospital becomes exceedingly difficult.
Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4
questions.solution:
A) 'Deteriorated' का use होगा क्योंकि "deteriorated" का अर्थ होता है खराब होना या गिरावट आना। Sentence में mention है कि सड़क की स्थिति इतनी खराब हो गई है कि मरीजों को अस्पताल ले जाना भी मुश्किल हो गया है। इसलिए, 'deteriorated' यहां सही है। जबकि 'Escalated' का अर्थ होता है बढ़ना या तेज होना, 'Separated' का अर्थ होता है अलग होना, और 'Connected' का अर्थ होता है जुड़ा होना, जो इस संदर्भ में सही नहीं हैं।
'Deteriorated' will be used because it means to become worse or decline. The sentence indicates that the road's condition has worsened to the point where even transporting patients to the hospital has become difficult, making 'deteriorated' appropriate here. In contrast, 'Escalated' means to increase or intensify, 'Separated' means to be divided, and 'Connected' means linked, which do not fit this context.

questions.q:
Comprehension:
In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.
Development in Bhopalaram village, situated in the Lunkaransar block of Bikaner, Rajasthan, has come to a halt due to the lack of proper roads. The absence of a _____1_____ road is a significant challenge for the nearly two thousand residents in the village. According to 47-year-old resident Baluram Jat, the main road connecting the village to the block headquarters was constructed around eight years ago and has not been maintained _____2______, rendering it _____3_____.The road's ______4_____ condition has made it challenging even for families to transport patients to the hospital. During Vimla's childbirth, the ambulance broke down due to the damaged road, forcing the family to arrange a private vehicle to reach the hospital. Vimla, a 28-year-old young woman from the village, noted that her condition worsened due to the road's large potholes. She highlighted that many pregnant women in the village prefer going to their parental homes for childbirth due to these challenges. ______5______, for those unable to do so, the journey to the hospital becomes exceedingly difficult.
Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5
questions.solution:
B) 'However' का use होगा क्योंकि "however" का अर्थ होता है "फिर भी" या "इसके बावजूद।" Sentence में mention है कि कुछ महिलाएँ गर्भावस्था के दौरान अपने माता-पिता के घर चली जाती हैं, लेकिन जो ऐसा नहीं कर पातीं, उनके लिए अस्पताल की यात्रा बहुत कठिन हो जाती है। यहाँ पर 'However' सही है क्योंकि यह वाक्य के दोनों भागों के बीच विरोधाभास (contrast) को दर्शाता है। जबकि 'Ever' का अर्थ "कभी" होता है, 'Whenever' का अर्थ "जब भी" होता है, और 'Moreover' का अर्थ "इसके अलावा" होता है, जो इस context में उपयुक्त नहीं हैं।
'However' will be used because it means "nonetheless" or "despite that." The sentence explains that while some pregnant women prefer going to their parental homes for childbirth, for those who can't, the journey to the hospital becomes exceedingly difficult. 'However' fits here as it shows the contrast between the two ideas. Whereas, 'Ever' means "at any time," 'Whenever' means "every time," and 'Moreover' means "in addition," which do not suit this context.
